info.description: Local-only HTTP API served by papersd (DESIGN §13, docs/ADR/rest-api.md). Disabled by default; binds 127.0.0.1 or ::1 only. Every endpoint except /health needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with the scopes listed in x-required-scopes (the same daemon decision as IPC, CLI and MCP). Requests with a Host other than 127.0.0.1/localhost/[::1] plus the API port, or with a browser Origin that is not configured, are refused. Limits: JSON bodies 1048576 bytes, import bodies 5242880 bytes, URI 16384 bytes, 30 s per request (120 s for imports, exports, DOI lookups and bulk operations), 32 concurrent requests. Errors: {"error":{"code","message","details","request_id"}}. Paging: papers default limit 50, full text default 10 pages / 100000 characters, search query at most 4096 bytes.
